summary:
Plan of w237 (supervision r214-r216) in plan.md. It replaces 3-plan, whose question is answered: reading A.
All three scenarios are red only on missing steps: one shared Given and four Thens, to be added to tests/scenarios/supervision_faults_steps.py.
Faults.checkout_changes already leaves out other initiatives' parts (d8f57cc8). No production behaviour changes (reading A).
The Given binds the write of .shop/work/i2/initiative.md to a session of i2 (p2's gate), made while i1's researcher works, and has that session commit the file before it ends. The scenarios then hold on every run.
The file set is the coordinator's: the step module and scripts/supervise_faults.py (unchanged in behaviour).
No existing test breaks (notes part 3).
Open cases left for the implementer to name: how to order i2's commit after i1's researcher ends, whether the gate is the right i2 session, a later rewrite of i2's initiative.md, and the stale Run.worker docstring.
